expectation: Cytoplasmic, granular signal around nuclei of macrophages/monocytes; common in tumour, scattered single cells in stroma and tumour, denser in stromal/immune-rich areas; dimmer on DCs and some others. Should overlap a subset of CD163+ cells.
observed: A: scattered bright cells in every ROI, denser in stroma, one ROI with large confluent patches. B/C: sparse cells with cytoplasmic signal. D: cytoplasm lit around blue nuclei. E: CD68 cells sit largely on CD163+ cells (white), with some CD68-only.
why: Discrete cytoplasmic-staining cells scattered through the stroma that largely co-localise with CD163+ macrophages, as expected for CD68.
notes: CD68 marks distinct cells with cytoplasm around their nuclei, scattered through the tissue and mostly on CD163+ cells in row E. One ROI has large confluent bright patches, possibly dense macrophage areas or artefact, but the verdict does not rest on them.
